<thought>We need to determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups in the molecule. The only way to get information about the molecule is to request its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for carbon atoms. Methyl carbons typically appear in the range ~10‑30 ppm. By counting distinct signals in that region we can infer the number of CH₃ groups. We'll request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
